coverage_limits: No printed REDCap completion fields or repeat-instance/access-group metadata.
Non-registration sources lack printed study record ID; link only through source MRN/name/DOB and registration study-ID anchor.
Selected radiobuttons are large circles around printed option text; existing4-20pt near-square control filter drops them.
Narrative radiology reports require explicit phrase, negation and measurement mapping. Unmentioned findings are not automatically negative.
Conditional questions remain physically visible when skipped; no inference of logical applicability or unchecked zero solely from print presence.
Handwriting-style answers are native PDF font text. This does not validate real handwriting OCR.
Procedure pain location/quality/other symptoms are free text, not all canonical checkbox choices; absent stage explicitly reads Not performed.
Report signers are not the catalog six named spine-reader choices.

method.ellipse_candidates: Native path bounds4-25pt high,8-400pt wide;20-512segments with>80%Bezier segmentpoints. These are candidatecounts only, independently visually checked, not production shape validation.
method.checkbox_square_candidates: Native4-12pt near-square4/5segment paths, physical presence only.
method.record_identity: Exact MRN plus NFKC/case-normalized source name and literalDOB; allsourceidentitiesconsistent. StudyID only anchored from registration footer.
method.text: pypdf native extraction; visible handwriting-styled fonts remain native text.
